run_DBIR_evaluation: run the DBIR model evaluation for new view synthesis on CO3D categories using main
evaluate_dbir_for_category: evaluate the DBIR model for a given CO3D category and task type
create_Task_enum: create a Task enum with SINGLE_SEQUENCE or MULTI_SEQUENCE evaluation task values
aggregate_nvs_results: aggregate new view synthesis evaluation results across multiple categories for a task
review_evaluate_dbir_for_category: review the evaluate_dbir_for_category function to understand DBIR model evaluation with LPIPS metrics
